mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 7.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 7.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates robust demand conditions that support corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) shows no statistical significance (p>0.05) in regression of 20d returns, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production rising above 100.5 (index) indicates easing supply constraints that boost manufacturing output and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 100.5, or Rank IC for INDPRO signal is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly payroll growth exceeding 100,000 jobs (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 100,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 900,000 units (HOUST) signals robust residential construction activity that drives economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 900.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Combined federal funds rate below 0.5% and CPI index below 235.0 indicates stable monetary conditions that encourage risk-taking, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS * CPIAUCSL) shows no statistical significance (p>0.05) in regression of 20d returns, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP level exceeding 17,000 billion dollars (GDPC1) reflects a strong economic foundation that supports corporate profitability and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 > 17000.0, or Rank IC for GDPC1 signal is below 0.02.
